description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of a premium Internet bandwidth plan
description_zh: 修改公网精品带宽的带宽大小
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-network-package-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-package-id np-cxj99qb8d34vo0000 --bandwidth 10 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNetworkPackageBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the premium Internet bandwidth plan
parameters.name: network_package_id

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the premium Internet bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbit/s.    

If the premium bandwidth plan uses the subscription billing method, the valid values are 2 to 1000.
If the premium bandwidth plan uses the pay-as-you-go billing method and the metering method is pay-by-data-transfer (PayByTraffic), the valid values are 2 to 200.
If the premium bandwidth plan uses the pay-as-you-go billing method and the metering method is pay-by-bandwidth (PayByBandwidth), the valid values are 2 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
公网精品带宽的带宽大小。单位：Mbps。    

如果是包年包月精品带宽，则取值范围是2\~1000。
如果是按量付费精品带宽，且类型是按使用流量计费（PayByTraffic），则取值范围是2\~200；
如果是按量付费精品带宽，且类型是按固定带宽计费（PayByBandwidth），则取值范围是2\~1000
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the resource ownership in the reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not using the reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid
